svg.data-weight-note: 16.75 lb (7.6 kg) for the 48-port PoE switch, as shipped with three fans, two StackWise adapter blanks, one power supply blank and the default power supply (spec Table 1-1)
svg.data-stackwise-adapter-weight: 0.25 lb (0.11 kg) for a StackWise stacking adapter, 0.1 lb (0.05 kg) for an adapter blank (spec Table 1-1)
svg.data-poe-budget: 390 W with one PWR-C2-640WAC (Table 1-13); 780 W with two 640 W DC supplies (Table 1-14)
svg.data-poe-power-per-port: up to 15.4 W (IEEE 802.3af) and up to 30 W PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at) per port (PoE+ and Cisco UPOE Ports)
svg.data-power-supply-options: PWR-C2-250WAC, PWR-C2-640WAC, PWR-C2-1025WAC, PWR-C2-640WDC (Power Supply for Catalyst 3650-24TS/PS/TD/PD and 3650-48TS/PS/FS/TD/PD/FD/FQ/PQ/TQ)
svg.data-psu-redundancy: two supply slots; the switch operates on one or two supplies, and on two AC, two DC or one of each
svg.data-operating-temp: -5 to +45 C up to 1500 m, -5 to +40 C up to 3000 m, -5 to +35 C up to 4000 m, -5 to +30 C up to 5000 m with an AC supply (spec Table 1-1)
svg.data-stacking: StackWise-160; a 3650 cannot stack with a 3850 (StackWise Ports)
svg.data-usb-storage: USB Type A port for Cisco USB flash drives of 64 MB to 1 GB
svg.data-uplink-optics: SFP on G1 and G2; SFP or SFP+ on G3/TE3 and G4/TE4; an SFP+ module in an SFP-only slot does not operate

g.data-output: +12 V at 20.83 A and -54 V at 14.6 A
g.title: psu-1--module
